DOJ Warns Democratic Senator of ‘Consequences’ Over Trump Investigations—What Can It Actually Do?

The Department of Justice (DOJ) has warned Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren of Massachusetts that she could face "significant legal consequences" if she fails to preserve records related to potential Congressional investigations involving allies of President Donald Trump .
